title: Comic Finishing Materials, Tones, Effect Lines, Rulers & Perspective
objective: Expose ARI-governed comic materials such as brushes, fonts, tones/halftones, pattern/background materials and decoration stamps plus speed/action lines, perspective/symmetry/radial/snap guides and reusable effect presets. Material bytes/provenance remain ARI-owned.
acceptance: Comic brushes, fonts, tones/halftones, pattern/background materials and decoration stamps are referenced through governed ARI material/provenance identity rather than copied into an SAA-only material ledger.
Speed/action lines are explicit governed finishing/effect state bound to existing SAA project/page/panel/layer identities.
Perspective, symmetry, radial and snap guides remain explicit reversible authoring-guide state and cannot silently rewrite Scene, Character or narrative truth.
Reusable effect presets retain stable material/effect references and provenance relationships.
Material bytes and provenance remain ARI-owned; SAA stores only bounded composition/effect references required by comic authoring.
SAA-23 drawing/layer identity and primitive-authority boundaries remain sealed and are consumed without duplicate renderer or brush-engine authority.
Provider-off/local authoring remains valid where governed local/native materials are available.
SAA-25 and later 3D/scroll/print/multimedia/interchange/publication behavior remain unauthorized.
boundaries: SAA-24 owns comic finishing composition/guide/effect semantics only; ARI remains canonical owner of material bytes and provenance.
No duplicate material, asset, Character, Scene, Dialogue, AAI or narrative ledger may be created.
Guides and effect presets cannot silently mutate source-domain truth or become canonical Scene/Character state.
No proprietary vendor code, private formats, assets, protected expression or undocumented protocols may be copied.
Provider-off/local operation remains valid for supported governed materials.
SAA-25 remains blocked until verified SAA-24 closeout.
next_action: Await a later explicit owner Continue before governed-starting SAA-24.
